ANSWER:

Repository validity is a fingerprint match, not a git or timestamp comparison — git HEAD/branch is explicitly "metadata only, never source identity" (src/view/git.rs:4). There are two layers:

1. Snapshot reuse validity (repository level): an update reuses a previous snapshot only when `manifest.fingerprint_matches(fingerprint) && manifest.config_matches(config)` (src/repository/build.rs:205-211, enforced at src/repository/build.rs:181-196, which raises `FingerprintMismatch`/`ConfigMismatch`). A stored snapshot's internal validity is verified by recomputing SHA-256 digests: `validate_manifest` re-checks `snapshot_digest` against `compute_snapshot_digest()` over canonical text (src/repository/artifact.rs:437-445, src/repository/manifest.rs:156-175), and `verify` re-digests every file artifact (src/repository/artifact.rs:489-536).

2. View index validity (the explicit "validity gate", §17-§19): `ValidityInputs::key()` is a SHA-256 (`digest::content_digest`) over the serialized `ValidityInputs` — schema tag, `content_fingerprint`, `analyzer_fingerprint`, `snapshot_config_digest`, and the link/candidate/graph policy fingerprints (src/view/validity.rs:28-42, 97-99). The index directory is keyed on this digest (src/view/validity.rs:145-147), so a directory hit implies all inputs matched; `ValidityInputs::validate` diffs stored vs. current inputs and returns a bounded `InvalidReason` (src/view/validity.rs:122-142, used by `index_valid` at src/view/index.rs:247-258).

Fingerprint sources:

- Analyzer fingerprint: `AnalyzerFingerprint::current(&ParserRegistry)` (src/repository/fingerprint.rs:79-98). Canonical text = `schema={SCHEMA_VERSION} abi={ANALYSIS_ABI_VERSION} ts_language_version=… ts_min_compatible=…` plus `{lang}={grammar.crate_name}:{grammar.crate_version}` for every `LanguageId::ALL` grammar, hashed with `digest::sha256_text` (SHA-256 via `sha2`, src/repository/digest.rs:24-33).
